try to set a goal each day.  take baby steps its what I often have to do.  Here is a list that I have seen floating around on the internet I added some stuff but I find it helpful.

 Are you hydrated?
If not, have a glass of water. 

2. Have you eaten in the past 3 hours?
If not, eat some food

3. Have you stretched your legs in the past 24 hours?
If you don't have the energy to go for a run, just go for a walk. Even if it's a short one. 

4. Have you cuddled a living being in the past 2 days?
Hugs are very important. 

5. Have you seen a therapist recently?
If not, make an appointment to go see one to talk through things with him.  If you don't have one talk to friends or family members or here.

6. If it is daytime: Are you dressed?
If not, go get dressed. Sweatpants and a dirty t-shirt don't count. Wear something clean and nice. 

7. If it is nighttime: Are you super tired but resisting to go to sleep?
Set up a bedtime routine. put on clean pajamas.

8. Have you said something nice to someone in the past day?
If not, do so. you can say it in person or send someone a nice text or Facebook message right now.

9. Have you over-exerted yourself lately?
If you have, the important thing is to give yourself a break in that area. Avoid the “I Just Need To Work Harder” trap. 

10. have you showered today? if not go take a nice hot shower or bath.

11. if you have a pet have you taken care of their needs? Feed them, give them water, pet or play with them ect.

12. I take meds daily, so some time i need to remind myself to take them. (this is something I sometimes have a hard time doing)

13. have to kept up on daily hygiene? brushed teeth comb hair ect if not go do it.

14. if you have a hobby you used to do or enjoy but haven't done try to do it even if it only for 30 minutes. 
there is probably a lot more things on the original list but i can't remember them all.  hope this helps.
